title: Meadow SMP
description: 🌷 Join Meadow SMP! A friendly Java & Bedrock survival server with custom biomes, land claims, quests, economy, optional PvP, and a welcoming community!
body:
## 🌷 Welcome to Meadow SMP

**Meadow SMP** is a friendly, cross-platform Minecraft server for players who love **survival, building, exploring, quests, economy, and playing together**.

## 🌱 Why play Meadow SMP?

🎮 **Java & Bedrock support**  
🌸 **Friendly community** with free quality-of-life features  
🌎 **Large survival world** with custom biomes that still feel vanilla  
🏡 **Protected land claims** with an easy menu  
🌳 **Automatic quests** with rewarding progression  
💰 **Player economy** with shops, orders, and auctions  
🦅 **Optional dash and double jump**  
⚔️ **Optional PvP** — play your way  
🎤 **Proximity voice chat**  
🗺️ **Live online world map**  
🌀 **Separate arena world** for kits and PvP  
🔥 **Always updated** to the latest Minecraft version  

## 🌟 Content Creators

Apply for **FREE Media Rank** with perks and promotion opportunities.

## ✨ Join Meadow SMP

Become part of a growing, welcoming community!

🌐 **IP:** meadowsmp.com  
📱 **Bedrock Port:** 19132  
💬 **Discord:** discord.gg/4NQugAEPg3  
🗺️ **Map:** map.meadowsmp.com
